title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 04

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Listen to Ms Brown. Where will the English lesson take place?
tasks.audioText: Hello, everyone. I'm Ms Brown, your English teacher. Tomorrow our lesson begins at ten fifteen in Room 8. Please bring your course book and a notebook. We will work in pairs for the first activity. Our lunch break is at half past twelve. If you are late, please wait outside until I invite you in.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What should students do if they are late?
tasks.audioText: Hello, everyone. I'm Ms Brown, your English teacher. Tomorrow our lesson begins at ten fifteen in Room 8. Please bring your course book and a notebook. We will work in pairs for the first activity. Our lunch break is at half past twelve. If you are late, please wait outside until I invite you in.
options: Wait outside until the teacher invites them in

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. Every Wednesday, Pavel meets two classmates in the library after lessons. They study English together for half an hour. One student reads a short paragraph, and the others ask questions about it. If they do not know a word, they look it up in a dictionary. Before they leave, they write down three useful expressions in a shared notebook. The group helps Pavel feel more confident when he speaks. Where does Pavel meet his classmates?
Reading 2. What do the students write in their shared notebook?
Choose the correct possessive form: 'This is Anna. ___ notebook is on the desk.'
Select the two sentences that are correctly formed in the Present Simple.
options: We not have a lesson today.
My sister doesn't drive to college.

tasks.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word: 'You use a ___ to find the meaning of an unfamiliar word.'
You do not understand the homework instruction. What should you say?
options: Could you explain the instruction, please?

tasks.prompt: Put these actions in a sensible order before an English lesson begins.
options: Open the course book at the correct page
Take out a notebook and a pen
Listen to the teacher's first instruction
correctOrder: Take out a notebook and a pen
Open the course book at the correct page
Listen to the teacher's first instruction

tasks.prompt: Write a short email of 60–80 words to a new classmate. Introduce yourself, say when you have English lessons, mention what you bring to class and suggest when you can study together.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the email introduces the writer and includes lesson time, classroom items and a proposed study time (0–2); the message has a suitable greeting, clear purpose and appropriate closing (0–2); polite requests/suggestions and basic grammar are understandable (0–2); study/time vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
